title: FINAL: max-effort-level re-audit of importer & rules-pack after thaw fixes
description:
Final INDEPENDENT gate of the epic. Perform a MAX-EFFORT re-audit of the
CANDIDATE regenerated rules-pack under the full complete-accurate-playable
standard.

THE PACK IS NOT YET RE-FROZEN when this bead runs. Formal regeneration and
re-freeze happen later, in eshyra-o9bd.14, and only after this audit's findings
are accepted in eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4. (This description was rewritten 2026-07-25;
the earlier text said the audit followed re-freeze. That order is inverted.)

Position in the closure chain:

  reference-engine certification (eshyra-olc5)
  -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1  full corpus recompilation and reclassification
  -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.2  permanent regression evidence
  -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3  candidate audit bundle + automated no-repeat gates
  -> eshyra-o9bd.16      THIS BEAD: independent max-effort audit of the candidate
  -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4  accept findings, certify zero-repeat closure
  -> eshyra-o9bd.14      formal regeneration and re-freeze
  -> eshyra-2zyy         re-enable post-freeze thaw-note gating

This bead consumes the candidate bundle produced by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3, whose
automated gates have already passed. Automated green is the ENTRY condition
here, not the exit — the value of this bead is finding what the automated gates
could not.

Independently re-run all gates from a clean install. Adversarially probe for:
untyped/null progression rows, missing feature headings, prose-only choices,
unreachable tables, mixed proficiency tokens, and any remaining consumer-side
SRD hardcoding or overlay dependence. Confirm the runtime smoke tests (create
every legal path; level representatives to 20) pass on generated data alone.

Report the ADR 0017 dimensions SEPARATELY rather than collapsing them into a
single "represented somewhere" result: reproducibility, source completeness,
structural fidelity, semantic modeling, runtime ownership/support, and
end-to-end playable validation.

Accepted findings feed eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4. Anything still failing is filed as a
new bead and routed through the finding registry (eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6) rather
than waived here. Use maximum reasoning effort — this is the durability check on
the playable rules product.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: The final max-effort audit should use the compiler guide's dimensions explicitly: reproducibility, source completeness, structural fidelity, semantic modeling, runtime ownership/support, and end-to-end playable validation. Report them separately instead of collapsing them into a single 'represented somewhere' result.
*** ORDER INVERTED (2026-07-25) ***
This bead previously depended on eshyra-o9bd.14, i.e. the final re-audit ran
AFTER regeneration and re-freeze. That edge is removed. The corrected closure
chain audits the CANDIDATE bundle BEFORE the formal re-freeze:

  19.6.1 corpus migration -> 19.6.2 regression/finding closure
  -> 19.6.3 candidate bundle + automated no-repeat gates
  -> eshyra-o9bd.16 (THIS BEAD) independent max-effort re-audit
  -> 19.6.4 accept results and certify zero-repeat closure
  -> eshyra-o9bd.14 formal regeneration and re-freeze
  -> eshyra-2zyy re-enable post-freeze thaw-note gating

SCOPE CHANGE: this bead now audits a candidate, pre-freeze artifact rather than a
frozen one. Its original description ("After ... the pack is regenerated/re-
frozen, perform a MAX-EFFORT re-audit") reflects the old order — read the
dependency graph, not that sentence, for sequencing. Everything else about the
max-effort standard stands.

This bead is deliberately NOT superseded by the new program: eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3
generates the candidate and passes automated gates, but independent review
belongs here.
